text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then how about this song?! 
Hmm-hmm-hmm! Hoo-hoo-yeah♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No way, absolutely not. Besides, playing 
custom entrance music for just one person 
isn't normal, is it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, music really lifts the spirits and 
fills you with so much energy!”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, I won't be nervous 
anymore!! Men won't be scary at all, 
yeeeeees!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Mind your own business. Even if I'm not 
good with men, it has nothing to do with 
you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, I don't need it. I'm leaving 
now. I've got training."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Besides... as for me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not like you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, Dober-senpai!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... And away they went. Mmm-mmm, 
track hunting really is tough, yes?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-san! You're just in time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Please help brainstorm too, Trainer! A 
dedicated entrance theme song for 
Dober-senpai!
choice_data_list: Why make entrance music for her?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... Hmm... please come along 
with me for a bit!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Look at Dober-senpai run! That sharpness! 
She runs like the wind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running right where my gaze falls, Mejiro 
Dober displays a flawless, waste-free 
stride, just as El Condor Pasa said.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat Dober-senpai when she's 
running like that... giving it her 
absolute all, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If I can run like that in the real race 
too, it'll surely be the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If only Dober-senpai could race with 
all her heart without caring about anyone 
else watching...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, earlier, I feel 
like you mentioned something about being 
nervous or not being good with men."
choice_data_list: I get nervous when people watch me, huh.

I get nervous when people watch me, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...I understand how you feel, 
Dober-senpai.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because without this mask, El was just a 
cowardly crybaby who couldn't even stand 
in front of people.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that's exactly why!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just like El's mask, I wish Dober-senpai 
had something to fire up her spirit, too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I need entrance music! 
Trainer! Do you have any 
recommendations!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A song that's thrilling, fun, and fills 
you with energy! What kind of song is 
that?!
choice_data_list: Why not use the live songs as a reference?

Maybe the kind of song a cheer squad would 
use?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see! A familiar song certainly does put 
one at ease!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's pick out some live concert 
tracks!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's settled, Trainer-san! With this song, 
I'm sure Dober-senpai will...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Dober-senpai! Your entrance music has been 
decided!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You still haven't given up?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! With this song, Dober-senpai will be 
bursting with courage and energy, yeeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Uma! Pyoi! Legendary!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
............ I'll hear your reasons out, 
just in case.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whenever El listens to this song, it fills 
me with super duper energy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Please sing this song as you take on the 
race! Fire yourseeeelf up, YEEES!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Are you kidding me? In the first place, 
I told you I'm nothing like you—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, courage will surge through 
me just like when El puts on her mask!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Say goodbye to being a wimpy crybaby, and 
run for real with El!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like I'm weak, nor am I 
crying.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still... yeah. You and I, maybe we aren't 
completely different after all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
! That smile! Did you like the entrance 
music El picked for you!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll pass on that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Dober give an awkward smile 
despite her exasperation, El Condor Pasa 
couldn't help but laugh along.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case, El will write the 
lyrics...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hot and blazing lyrics really are the best 
after all, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After an hour of racking my brain, the 
lyrics to send to Mejiro Dober were 
finally complete!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fight, fight, a real showdown~♪ Fighting 
spirit! Fighting spirit! Dropkick♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Go, go, right there! Take down the foe! 
There's nothing, nothing to fear~♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Run, run, dash through! Dober, Dober, 
Mejiro Dober♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait...! What is that song?! It's totally 
draining my energy, stop it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho!? Did you manage to relax properly?! 
It's a success, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
With this, I should be able to deliver a 
marvelous run, yeeeesss!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Of course that's not true! Besides, 
dropkicks are out of the question, right?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! Just give it a run and 
see!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing El Condor Pasa wouldn't give up, 
Mejiro Dober reluctantly returned to the 
track and started running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that time was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No... way... My time actually got 
faster...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful run!! Just watching it 
was so thrillinggg!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“...W-Well... I suppose it did take some 
of the tension off.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
After being forced to listen to such a 
weird song... With... those kinds of 
lyrics...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, hehe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, weren't those fiery lyrics!? I'm 
super glad you liked it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then right away, next is a match with El—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's all for today. ...See you next 
time.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, while it was rejected as an 
entrance song, seeing Mejiro Dober laugh 
happily brought a smile to El Condor 
Pasa's face as well.
